summary: Iteration 57 — Media upload + per-platform social links + Settings CRUD for social-platforms. Backend pytest 9/9 PASSED. Frontend Playwright smoke 100% — all required data-testids resolve and full venue flow renders correctly. Verified: GET /api/settings/social-platforms seeds 9 defaults (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter / X, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Telegram, Website); POST creates with name+icon, duplicate name → 400, empty/whitespace name → 400; PUT updates name+icon; DELETE works (second DELETE → 404). Venue POST/PUT with photos as ARRAY of Cloudinary URLs persists & GET returns the array verbatim; social_links as ARRAY of {platform,url} objects persists round-trip identically; legacy multiline-string photos still load (backend returns as-is, frontend MediaFields normalizes). /api/upload accepts multipart PNG and returns Cloudinary url+public_id. Frontend: Settings sidebar exposes tab-social-platforms which renders SocialPlatformsPanel with 9 seeded sp-edit-* rows; creating a 10th via sp-name-input + sp-icon-input + sp-submit-btn increments to 10. Venues page → 'Yeni' opens modal containing photo-upload-field + photo-upload-input + social-links-field + social-add-btn; clicking social-add-btn injects social-platform-0 + social-url-0 + social-remove-0; Platform Select dropdown lists all 9 seeded platforms and Instagram selection persists into the row; 'Video / virtual tur linki' remains a plain text input (NOT photo upload).

issues: Carryover: Radix Dialog 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' console warning. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) Add aria-describedby / DialogDescription to vendor-create DialogContent to clear Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: PhotoUploadField correctly normalizes legacy multiline-string `value` into an array client-side — no data migration required for old org_* docs.
SocialLinksField gracefully handles 3 shapes: array of {platform,url}, array of plain strings (mapped to {platform:'',url:string}), and legacy newline-string. Robust.

Backend create_org_vendor / update_org_vendor blindly accept `data: dict` — no schema validation on photos/social_links shapes. Acceptable trade-off given dynamic per-module schemas, but any future XSS via stored URL must be sanitized on render (currently rendered with onError fallback only — fine for trusted Cloudinary URLs).

/api/settings/social-platforms PUT enforces no duplicate-name check (unlike POST) — renaming a platform to an existing name would succeed and create silent duplicates. Low-priority but inconsistent with POST.
PUT /api/settings/social-platforms/{id} requires at least one field via 400 if update dict empty — good.
Duplicate-name match is case-sensitive ({'name': name} exact). 'facebook' vs 'Facebook' would both insert. Minor.
PhotoUploadField uploads files sequentially in a for-loop (not parallel) — fine for typical 1-5 image uploads; consider Promise.all if users upload >10 at once.

DELETE /api/settings/social-platforms/{id} does NOT scrub the platform name from existing org_* `social_links` rows. A deleted platform name would persist as orphan text in vendor records (UI Select shows blank). Acceptable for MVP but document the behavior.
